description:
£135PPPW - My Property Box are delighted to welcome to the market this furnished four-bedroom maisonette in the popular area of Jesmond.

The property boasts four double bedrooms, double glazing, gas central heating, neutral décor throughout and attractive wood flooring. The modern kitchen comes fully equipped with a fridge freezer, washing machine, oven and electric hob, while the newly fitted bathroom features an electric shower.

Ideally located close to West Jesmond Metro Station, the property offers excellent transport links into Newcastle City Centre and convenient access to Newcastle and Northumbria Universities, as well as the city's Dental School, Medical School and Business School.

To arrange a viewing, contact My Property Box today and speak to our Lettings Team.
